_comment: Same person, two spellings. The 1/1 archive writes drivers the way the paddock says them out loud; the official 2020 Topps Chrome checklist writes them the way they appear on the entry list. Both gen-market-mock.mjs and build-archive.ts read this file so the two spellings never drift apart. Key = the name used by the checklist / market item, value = the name used by the archive.
